artworks.title: The Wrath of Achilles
artworks.description: Tiepolo's assembly scene — Agamemnon and Achilles at the quarrel that opens the Iliad and sends the best of the Achaeans to his ships.

artworks.title: The Anger of Achilles
artworks.description: David's moment before the sword — Athena staying Achilles' hand when Agamemnon seized Briseis.

artworks.title: Thetis and Zeus
artworks.description: Mengs' Olympus — Thetis asking Zeus to honour her son while Achilles sits idle by the ships.
